scope.flow: Router/Core swap transaction execution without a user-specified deadline
scope.environment: Decentralized exchange Router and underlying Core contracts

statements.text: The Router and Core contracts do not allow users to specify a deadline for their swap transactions.
Router slippage protection is limited to calculatedAmountThreshold and sqrtRatioLimit, which only protect against price movements relative to execution time.
A swap transaction can be held by a validator or remain in the mempool for an extended period.
Market conditions can change unfavorably for the user during the delay.
The delayed swap transaction is executed after the extended delay.
Absence of a deadline parameter means no time-based guard prevents execution of the swap after a significant delay.
Users may have their transactions executed at unexpected times.
Users may suffer unwanted trades or loss of opportunity from execution under changed conditions.
A swap transaction should not be executable after a user-specified deadline; execution after that bound violates the intended time protection.

ambiguities: Report does not state that a specific delayed transaction was actually observed; delay and execution are described as possible.
No explicit actor authorization or permissionless-call claim is made; validator/mempool holding is described as a possibility.
No concrete deadline value, delay duration, or numeric bound is supplied.
Whether slippage thresholds would still block the delayed execution in a given case is not established.
